Dear Luca,

I'm writing this from the other side of the door. I know you were studying so diligently that your grades should have been yours all along.

The test was tough because it tested what we call "hard work," not just memorization. You did everything right in class and on practice problems, but something happened outside of those boundaries—maybe stress or an error with one of our books—and the weight took its toll.

Please forgive me for being harsh. Grades are final, and they matter more than any argument can change them. But remember how much effort went into every problem? That is why you passed; failure is only a passing grade.

Take care of yourself now, okay? If you ever need someone to talk to about it, say so. I will be here when you feel better.

With love,
Mom
